dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: Hehe, that's right! As the best bard in Teyvat — well, second-best, after Lord Barbatos — I've got a masterpiece in the making!

dialogues.speaker: Elsie
dialogues.text: It's still a work-in-progress, but I wouldn't mind giving you a little preview! After all, you've helped me gather all that inspiration!

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: Ahem! Then I'll start. Just a little bit!

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: "The North Wind blows, the North Wind blows, the West Wind starts when the North Wind goes; the West Wind blows, the West Wind blows, the South Wind starts when the West Wind goes..."

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: "...It blows and blows and blows some more; when will our knights all come back home? When they'll come, we cannot say, let's sit and drink the night away."

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: Haha, a listener after my own heart! But the drinks will have to wait. Once I'm done writing by the light of the stars, we'll drink to the last note!

choices.text: Oof, those lyrics were pretty basic...

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: H-Hey! This is art! Good grief... They even have a saying in Liyue, "The finest songs find the fewest ears"! Yep. That's exactly what's going on here!

choices.text: Sorry, I have something else to do.

response.speaker: Elsie
response.text: Ehh... alright, no worries! Once I'm done writing by the light of the stars, this tune will echo through taverns all across Teyvat!
